evidence_sentence: The constructor reads predefined values and handler type from the stream, checks if the size allows for a name, and reads it if possible.
rationale: The fixed implementation adds an explicit lower-bound check, returning when size is smaller than AP4_FULL_ATOM_HEADER_SIZE+20 before computing name_size. The vulnerable implementation has no such validation; it subtracts from the unsigned size and only returns when the resulting value is exactly zero. The remaining statements about handling Pascal/C strings, null termination, and releasing the temporary buffer apply to both versions.
rewritten_docstring: The constructor reads predefined values and handler type from the stream, determines the handler-name portion from the atom size, and reads it when present. It handles both Pascal and C string formats for the handler name, ensuring proper null termination and memory management.
